prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one decorative raster orb for a sophisticated dark AI workforce dashboard, delivered as a standalone isolated asset, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: create a single centered glossy dark glass cosmic violet energy sphere, 1024 by 1024 square image. The sphere should occupy about 75% of image width and height, with ample transparent margins all around.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with alpha channel. Only the sphere and a very restrained low-opacity violet glow belong in the image. Do not render a checkerboard pattern.
Subject and material: a dimensional round glass orb with near-black transparent indigo interior, delicate purple and cobalt thin luminous rim with subtle organic electric filaments wrapping around portions of the spherical edge. Its interior has only a few extremely subtle tiny blue speckles. An asymmetrical small soft specular reflection near the upper right establishes glossy curved volume. Keep most of the interior peacefully dark with subtle smoky-indigo light transmission, not a featureless flat black disk.
Lighting and mood: elegant, quiet, mysterious, restrained science-fiction luxury; purple edge strongest toward upper right and left lower curve, irregular thin highlights make the sphere organic.
Color palette: deep black, translucent midnight indigo, violet, cool cobalt; avoid cyan, red, pink.
Composition: exactly one complete centered sphere, perfectly circular outline in perspective, no cropping, no ground plane, no cast shadow except subtle surrounding glow.
Constraints: NO interface, NO words, NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO faces, NO people, NO other objects. No bright center, no explosion, no thick neon ring, no equatorial stripe, no planet surface, no exaggerated nebula cloud. The image must remain usable at small icon sizes as well as cropped inside a sidebar promotion card.

reference.usage: Viewed for style direction only; no source image was supplied to generation.

inspection.notes: One complete glossy dark indigo sphere with violet/cobalt filaments, sparse interior speckles, and upper-right specular highlight. Original generated bytes copied without transformation.
